clips.title: The story
paras: Across Mulgore, swoops circle above the plains, and their quills mark a hunter’s skill. Tauren bring these feathers to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village.

Swoops ride high above Mulgore’s grasslands, where they are hard to track. Young tauren hunters and travelers in Bloodhoof Village seek a trophy quill to prove their cleverness and resolve. Bringing one to elders such as Harken Windtotem honors the hunter’s clan and shows the sharp senses needed to thrive on the plains.
